hooks.text: Saturn has an icy moon shaped like a sponge.
One of Saturn's moons is forty percent empty space.
Meteor strikes on Saturn's strangest moon blast zero debris.
Why is Saturn orbited by a giant bath sponge?

title: The Saturnian Moon That Acts Like a Sponge
description: Hyperion looks like a giant sponge because it is roughly forty percent empty space. Incoming meteors compress its porous ice inward rather than blasting debris out.

beats.text: Saturn has an icy moon shaped like a sponge.
beats.visual: Cassini false-color image of Saturn moon Hyperion showing sponge texture, 2005

beats.text: When NASA's Cassini spacecraft arrived in 2005, its craters made no sense.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of Cassini spacecraft flying past Saturn's moons, 2005

beats.text: Normal impacts blast debris everywhere, but Hyperion had almost none.
beats.visual: Cassini close-up view of heavily cratered sponge terrain on Hyperion, 2005

beats.text: The answer is that forty percent of Hyperion is empty space.
beats.visual: Cassini full-disk image showing irregular shape and porous surface of Hyperion, 2005

beats.text: Because it's porous water ice, meteors don't blast rock outward.
beats.visual: Cassini high-resolution view of deep honeycomb craters on moon Hyperion, 2005

beats.text: They punch directly inward, compressing the ice like foam.
beats.visual: Diagram showing impact compression of porous ice compared to rock excavation, 2007

beats.text: Gravitational tugs from giant Titan also keep Hyperion tumbling chaotically.
beats.visual: Cassini photograph showing giant moon Titan against the limb of Saturn, 2005

beats.text: Its spin wobbles through space in completely unpredictable directions.
beats.visual: Diagram illustrating chaotic rotation and tumbling axis of moon Hyperion, 1989

beats.text: That wild tumble belongs to Saturn's strangest frozen world.
beats.visual: Cassini wide-angle photograph of tumbling moon Hyperion against dark space, 2005

better_than_last: Applies the mystery structure by withholding the 40% porosity reveal until beat 4 and crafting a seamless final line that loops directly back into the hook.
